descripcion:
QF Deportes trae las noticias del fútbol ecuatoriano y del deporte en un solo lugar, de la mano de QF Producciones.

• Noticias de LigaPro, Serie A y Serie B.
• Resultados, previas y análisis.
• Selección de Ecuador y ecuatorianos en el exterior.
• Transmisiones y contenido de QF Producciones.

Lectura rápida y cómoda en tu iPhone, sin necesidad de crear cuenta.
texto_promocional: Las noticias del fútbol ecuatoriano al día, de QF Producciones.
notas_revisor:
1. Screen recording (physical iPhone, latest iOS): {video}

2. Purpose and audience: QF Deportes is the official app of QF Producciones, a live-sports production company in Ecuador. It is for football fans in Ecuador who want news about the national leagues (LigaPro Serie A and B), the national team and Ecuadorian players abroad, plus QF Producciones live-stream announcements.

3. How to use it (no account, no login): open the app; the home page lists the latest news. Tap any article to read it; use the menu to browse sections. No setup is needed.

4. External services: our own website qfproducciones.com (news written by QF Producciones). Third-party advertising and analytics scripts are blocked inside the iOS app. No sign-in, no payments, no AI services.

5. Regional differences: none. Content is the same in every region (news about Ecuadorian football).

6. Regulated industry / third-party material: news is written by QF Producciones. Team names and logos appear only as editorial/news references; no match broadcasts or protected video are offered in the app.
